chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ahmad ibn 'Umar al-Halabi, from Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:
I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) while he was praying, and I counted for him in the bowing (ruku') and prostration (sujood) sixty glorifications (tasbihat).
ai.seo_question: How many glorifications did the Prophet's family recite during bowing and prostration according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the devotional depth of Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) prayer, where he performed sixty glorifications in bowing and prostration, reflecting the Shia emphasis on abundant dhikr as a means of spiritual refinement. This practice underscores the scholarly view that the Sunnah of the Imams includes not just the structure of prayer but also the richness of remembrance within it, aligning with the Quranic command to remember Allah abundantly. The high count suggests a level of contemplative focus that distinguishes the Imam’s worship as a model for the faithful.
